class Counter {
  get count() {
    while (!true) return 1;
  }
  get alternate() {
    while (!!false) return 2;
  }
}
const values = {
  get negated() {
    if (!true) return 3;
  },
  get grouped() {
    if ((false)) return 4;
  },
  get both() {
    if (true && (false)) return 5;
  },
  get logical() {
    if (true && !false) return 6;
  },
};
console.log(new Counter().count, new Counter().alternate);
console.log(values.negated, values.grouped, values.both, values.logical);
